an7.50:1.6: ‘For I, brahmin, live the chaste life intact, impeccable, spotless, and unmarred, full and pure.’”
an7.50:4.1: Nor do they giggle and play and have fun with ladies;
an7.50:5.1: Nor do they gaze into a lady’s eyes;
an7.50:6.1: Nor do they listen through a wall or rampart to the sound of ladies laughing or chatting or singing or crying;
an7.50:7.1: Nor do they recall when they used to laugh, chat, and have fun with ladies;
